title: Flat scalar comparison is the evaluation-normalized resolution roof
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe and $\varphi:R\to S$ a morphism of commutative ring sheaves whose ordinary scalar extension $E=S\otimes_R-$ is exact. Use module derived categories, K-flat tensor and normalized derived internal Hom $H_R,H_S$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model] [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Write $Q$ for localization of complexes in $D(R)$ and $U:D(S)\to D(R)$ for termwise restriction of scalars along $\varphi$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Let $P$ be a flat-term K-flat $R$-complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] and $C$ any $R$-complex. In the strict models [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-models] [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-roof], put $J=I_R(C)$, $B=\mathcal Hom_R(P,J)$, $F(M)=\mathcal Hom_R(P,I_R(M))$, $a_S:S\otimes_R B\to F(S\otimes_R J)$ and $v_S=F(S\otimes_R\eta_C)$. Then $v_S$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Let $c:E^{\mathbf L}H_R(QP,QC)\to H_S(E^{\mathbf L}QP,E^{\mathbf L}QC)$ be the transpose of scalar-extended evaluation, and let $\Theta$ be the evaluation-normalized scalar-adjunction isomorphism [lem-sfb-dc-hom-scalar-adjunction]. Under the canonical exact-extension representative identifications, $\Theta\,U(c)=[v_S]^{-1}[a_S]$. Equivalently $[v_S]\,\Theta\,U(c)=[a_S]$, with $[\ ]$ denoting localization. This equality is natural in both derived inputs and in compatible maps of coefficient rings; it requires neither finite freeness, filtered continuity nor boundedness.
